function.name: list-directory
function.description: Gets a list of files and directories within given directory path. Returns the contents of the given directory or exception description.

directory.description: Path from the working directory to the directory to be listed.

function.name: create-directory
function.description: Create new directory in given parent directory with given name if it doesn't exist. Returns empty string is case of success or exception description.

parentDirectory.description: Path from the working directory to the parent directory where new directory should be created.

name.description: Name of the new directory that should be created.

function.name: create-file
function.description: Create new file in given parent directory with given name if it doesn't exist. Returns empty string is case of success or exception description.

parentDirectory.description: Path from the working directory to the parent directory where new file should be created.

name.description: Name of the new file that should be created.

function.name: get-file-text
function.description: Reads file by given path. Returns text of the file or exception.

filePath.description: Path from working directory to the file that should be read.

function.name: set-file-text
function.description: Set given text to the file by given path. Returns text description of success or exception.

filePath.description: Path from working directory to the file that should be modified.

text.description: Text that should be written to the file.
